fusions.name: Tined Toss
fusions.desc: Hooks the target on a rack of tines and throws it: a weapon strike that deals 13 damage, makes it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and knocks it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Warning Stamp
fusions.desc: Stamps a shod hoof, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Bolt in Full Harness
fusions.desc: Springs you 3 tiles from where you stood and reduces the damage you take by 20% for 10 seconds. You move 20% faster for the first 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Flinch Turned Plate
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 40%, a shield worth 25% of your maximum health closes over you for 6 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.
